title: Linear media placeholder
description: An empty stand-in for a product screenshot or illustration: a faintly raised dark panel with a white-8% hairline and soft inner shade, in the shape of the slot it fills. Shows its child instead when one is given.
notes: size and radius come from className: the blocks pass the original slot's aspect ratio
name: linear-placeholder

props.name: children
props.description: a real image, video or screenshot; when empty the panel itself stands in

props.name: kind
props.description: frame: a bordered product window · patch: a soft borderless glow (illustrations)

props.name: label
props.description: a name for screen readers when the slot is empty
